shots.video_prompt: The warm amber lighthouse beam slowly rotates and sweeps across the dark water toward the camera, briefly flooding the whole frame with golden light, then passes on, revealing the white tower in silhouette under the moon. shots.voiceover: Forty-one years. The same light. The same sea.
shots.notes: Fade-in from black. cape_night referansında küre var: prompt'ta 'no glowing sphere' korunmalı. Huzme kameraya dönünce aşırı patlama (tam beyaz kare) olursa kurgucu o anı kısa tutar. [QA kare 2026-10-26: ONAY v1. Sağ altta ✦ filigran (iki varyantta da) → kurgucu delogo/kırpma.]
